name: Runtipi Companion
short_desc: Verified Runtipi backups through an existing rclone service
author: EckPhi
description: Creates verified local Runtipi app backups on a calendar schedule and transfers them through the authenticated API of the Rclone Mount app.

form_fields.label: Dashboard username
form_fields.hint: Username required to open the Companion dashboard.

form_fields.label: Dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Generated password required to open the Companion dashboard.

form_fields.label: Runtipi installation path
form_fields.hint: Absolute host path containing runtipi-cli, apps, app-data and backups.

form_fields.label: Backup host label
form_fields.hint: Subfolder used to isolate this server's remote backups.

form_fields.label: Backup hour
form_fields.hint: Local hour when scheduled backups start.

form_fields.label: Rclone API username
form_fields.hint: Use the GUI username configured in Rclone Mount.

form_fields.label: Rclone API password
form_fields.hint: Use the generated GUI password from Rclone Mount.

form_fields.label: Rclone backup target
form_fields.hint: Configured remote and backup path; no FUSE mount is used.
